### Does Age Impact Success in Formula One

My current undergraduate research is Formula One Sports Analytics. In Spring 2026 I looked into if age impacted the yearly points of a driver. With this I created a Generalized Additive Mixed Model of the ages of the drivers, the individual drivers, and the respective season (2016-2025).
